fields.name: Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa (Vārāṇasī)
fields.notes: A devotee of Vārāṇasī (his name is not given). Pained by the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs' blasphemy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he invited all of them and the Lord to his house; there Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī and his followers were won over to the holy name (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 7).

A Gauḍīya sādhu of Svarūpa Gañj in the days of Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī, who respected him and had Gauḍīya Maṭha brahmacārīs bring him supplies from the Yoga-pīṭha. Once, angry that his mind had been drawn to some fish, he tied his Deities with a rope and threw Them into the Gaṅgā; Bhaktisiddhānta then kept his brahmacārīs away: «you are not able to understand this bhāva». Not Vaṁśī dāsa Bābājī #1617 (Whisper, 11-11-2026).

fields.name: Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī (Raṇabāḍī)
fields.aka: Kṛṣṇa dāsa Bābājī (Raṇabāḍī), Kṛṣṇaprasāda Caṭṭopādhyāya (birth name), Siddha Bābā of Raṇabāḍī, Raṇabāḍī Bābā
fields.disappearance: About 1865, at Raṇabāḍī (Vraja); his anniversary is kept on the amāvasyā of Pauṣa (the record's text)
fields.place: Born at Mahammadpura (Bankura); Vṛndāvana (Madana-mohana temple); Raṇabāḍī in Vraja (kuṭīra and tomb)
fields.notes: Born Kṛṣṇaprasāda Caṭṭopādhyāya at Mahammadpura (Bankura), son of Gokulacandra; ran away to Vṛndāvana as a boy and lived some fifty years in bhajana at Raṇabāḍī. Took the tapta-mudrā at Dvārakā against Śrī Rādhā's word in a dream; in repentance gave up food and water, and after three months the fire of separation burned his body (about 1865), with Siddha Jagannātha dāsa Bābājī present. Friend of the Siddha Bābā of Govardhana; godbrother of Premadāsa Bābājī. His guru is not named.
